lines.text: You know my order, save me a seat
Finish my stories, laugh at my jokes
I stay too long when you look at me
Then I go quiet like I never spoke
I left little signs in the space we share
A look too long, a joke too thin
You smiled like nothing was even there
So I swallowed the words I almost let in
I told myself you had to know
Then watched you miss it and let me go
I’ve been dropping tiny hints
Hoping you would catch them
I’ve been loving you in silence
Calling this just friendship then
Tonight it’s just us in the same old room
You’re talking like I’m just a friend
Something in me breaks through the gloom
And I hear my own voice at the end
I don’t have a speech
I don’t have a plan
I just can’t keep holding
What’s shaking in my hands
I’ve been dropping tiny hints
Hoping you would catch them
I’ve been loving you in silence
Calling this just friendship then
I’m in love with you
Did you hear me?
I’m in love with you
